from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FairValueChangeIncome(BaseModel):
    """Fair value change income reported for a single company in a single document."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name the financial report belongs to")
    current_period_amount: float | None = Field(description="Current period fair value change income amount, or None if not reported")
    previous_period_amount: float | None = Field(description="Previous reporting period fair value change income amount, or None if not reported")
    current_period_name: str | None = Field(description="Label for current period (e.g. '2024年第一季度')")
    previous_period_name: str | None = Field(description="Label for previous period (e.g. '上年同期')")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g. '元', '万元')")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of report (e.g. '2024年第一季度财务报告')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the reported values")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    fair_value_change_incomes: list[FairValueChangeIncome]
